info.name: AlikoHub Platform — Master API (Exhaustive & Role-Differentiated)
info.description:
Complete and exact API collection for AlikoHub microservices gateway at https://api.consultancy.alikohub.com/api/v1.

Audited exhaustively against all controller decorators in apps/academy-service and apps/user-service.
Organized into dedicated role folders:
1. Public & Guest Endpoints (Unauthenticated)
2. Student Endpoints (Learning, Attendance, Skills, Clinical, Submissions)
3. Instructor & Faculty Endpoints (Courses, Cohorts, Grading, Rubrics, Clinical Supervision)
4. Admin & Commission Auditor Endpoints (Compliance Dossier, Credential Approvals, Seat-Time Audit)
